text:
Databases store and organize information so we can find it easily. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. NoSQL databases are more flexible and store data in different ways, such as documents.

To get information from a database, we write queries, which are special commands. Good data modeling helps us plan how to structure the data before we build the database. Indexes make searching faster by helping the database find data quickly. Choosing the right type of database depends on your needs.
